name: SentinelOne Singularity
summary: SentinelOne Singularity covers endpoint and cloud workload protection from one console. Singularity Complete is listed at $179.99 per endpoint per year and Commercial at $229.99, with those prices displayed for 5 to 100 workstations. Commercial adds identity detection and 90 days of data retention against 14 days on Complete. Enterprise pricing is by quote, and purchases go through authorized partners.

facts.text: SentinelOne describes one-click rollback and remediation, and the ability to isolate devices and kill malicious processes.
Singularity Complete keeps data for 14 days, while Commercial keeps it for 90 days.
Managed Threat Hunting and Managed Detection and Response appear in the comparison table as add-ons, and the page's table layout is hard to read, so confirm which apply to which plan.
The pricing page says prices may vary by region and partner availability, and that the partner's price controls if the two differ.

plans.name: Singularity Complete
plans.notes: Listed for 5 to 100 workstations. 14-day data retention

plans.name: Singularity Commercial
plans.notes: Listed for 5 to 100 workstations. Adds identity detection and 90-day retention

hiddenCosts: Taxes and other charges are not included in the listed prices.
Managed threat hunting and managed detection and response are add-ons.
